LifeLink

My graduation project: a blood donation platform with a donor app, a hospital app, and an admin app. I worked on all three, with my main focus on the hospital side.

Blood donation platform

Graduation project, team of 4

Donors sign up with their details, including blood type and location, and get a notification when a request matches their blood type. They book an appointment, go to the hospital, and earn points after donating.

Donors spend points on rewards such as a coffee voucher, a gym membership, or a health check-up. A chatbot answers common questions about donating blood, and the whole app works in Arabic and English.

My role: I worked across all three roles, with my main focus on the hospital side. There I developed the entire flow, from the first blood request to the points awarded after a donation, plus the hospital profile with its name, location, and statistics.

FlutterDartClean ArchitectureMVVMCubit / BLoCDioHiveJWT auth

The hospital flow I built

  1. 1Create a blood requestSet blood type, urgency, and patient details.
  2. 2Follow its statusTrack the request as it progresses.
  3. 3Review responding donorsSee which matching donors said yes.
  4. 4Schedule an appointmentBook a slot within the hospital's working hours and daily capacity.
  5. 5Scan the donor's QR codeCheck the donor in when they arrive.
  6. 6Check eligibilityConfirm the donor can give blood safely.
  7. 7Record the donationComplete it and award the donor their points.
